after.title: Jüdisch-babylonische Zaubertexte
after.citation: Stübe, Rudolf. Jüdisch-babylonische Zaubertexte. Halle a/S.: J. Krause, 1895.
after.notes: Complete Bayerische Staatsbibliothek scan held privately from the institution's IIIF service: 92 scan pages, printed extent xvi + 64 pages, assembled PDF SHA-256 ef983942f7fd.... The work is public domain; the library labels its digital object No Copyright - Non-Commercial Use Only. Printed pp. 13-18 catalogue nineteen items (seventeen bowls and two skulls), and pp. 22-27 transcribe and translate VA 2416.
